purpose: Measure the last unmeasured lever that could improve finalist A: the champion's OWN internal-estimator scaling (internal-2 -> internal-4). The phase-17 pipeline already certified the numerical equivalence of a 4-estimator run (max gap 1.19e-7) but never measured its performance -- the champion shipped internal-2. This screen answers whether the champion's geometry has headroom, using the certified runner under its own gates, with the full 559,708-row context.
why_this_is_safe_and_matched: the certified phase-17 runner performs its own gates: probe status PASS_REQUIRES_EXACT_FULL_B0, library source hashes, scripts/phase16_tabpfn.py source hash, B0 control EXACT_B0_HASH_MATCH, the internal-4 equivalence probe (status PASS, max gap <= 2e-6), and the immutable fold registry
params = the certified route-reference params with ONLY n_estimators changed to 4; the route view, seeds (1201), chunking (262144 cells), int8 KV cache, icl_bf16 and windows-MQA backend are unchanged
fold 0 only (the runner's continuation gates for fold>0 require earlier evaluation reports for the same tag, which is correct: this is a screen, not a promotion)

internal1_B0_fold0.note: the internal-1 -> internal-2 upgrade was worth +8.7e-5 on primary (+8.75e-5 shadow)

measured: equal-logit portfolio with aux10 vs the certified internal-2 portfolio (paired bootstrap 95% CI, B=2000, seed 7)
Spearman/logit-Pearson vs internal-2 route and vs champion v7

frozen_decision_rule.MATERIAL: paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of (portfolio_internal4 - portfolio_internal2) > 0 AND mean gain >= +1.5e-5 (the AGENTS admission bar). Consequence: a CONCRETE BUDGET EXTENSION REQUEST is produced with the measured numbers, because promotion needs ~13 GPU-h (5 OOF folds + 5 test folds at internal-4 cost) which exceeds the remaining balance. No submission without a full 5-fold OOF + certified test vector.
frozen_decision_rule.PLATEAU: CI includes 0 or mean gain < +1.5e-5. Consequence: champion A's internal-2 geometry is confirmed as the plateau; record and close.
frozen_decision_rule.no_threshold_movement: the bar is the repository's existing admission bar; it is not moved because of what internal-4 shows

non_goals: no submission from a fold-0 screen
no change to the certified champion artifacts
